blocks.text: Don't think of tenants as isolated databases.
Think of them as Enterprise Runtime Containers.
Each tenant is effectively its own enterprise operating environment.
The KoreVity platform supplies the runtime, while every tenant receives its own governed, isolated enterprise workspace with independent lifecycle management.
